description: Named by the fz-go4.31 minimalism audit (at bb8f05925/ae1f3f123). fz-go4.31 added 8 end-to-end tests driving the real loop into each ProductDriveError hook with exact assert_eq on the surfaced message/diagnostic. That makes 5 of the 8 pre-existing direct hook-calling tests (from fz-go4.19) redundant — subsumed byte-for-byte: string_error_reports_no_ready_producer_with_unresolved_waits, fatal_error_diagnostic_reports_no_ready_producer, string_error_reports_job_failed_without_the_job_run_error_details, fatal_error_job_failed_forwards_the_jobs_run_error_unchanged, fatal_error_diagnostic_reports_did_not_settle_without_last_wait_detail. Auditor proved deletion safe (11 remaining tests pass). KEEP the other 3 (string_error_reports_fact_wait_budget_exceeded, fatal_error_diagnostic_reports_fact_wait_budget_exceeded, string_error_reports_did_not_settle_with_last_wait) — their e2e counterparts only .contains/.starts_with the prefix, not the exact {:?}-formatted fact/last_wait suffix (the small-budget drive's exact fact value isn't cheaply predictable). ALTERNATIVELY, tighten those 3 e2e assertions to full equality, which lets all 8 direct tests go — the larger, cleaner change. Also extract fn add1_world(tel) -> (World, RootId): the add1.fz setup block is copy-pasted 4x (product_drive_test.rs:309/340/383/504, n>=2 rule). Test-only; two-lane audit. (The pub(crate)->pub(super) narrowing was already applied at the fz-go4.31 fold.)
title: Collapse redundant ProductDriveError hook tests + extract add1_world helper
